# freshdesk_time_entries (Data Source)

Every time entry the API returns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_time_entries" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `time_entries`.
- `time_entries` (Attributes List) Every time entry the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_entries))

<a id="nestedatt--time_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_entries`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (Number) ID of the agent who logged the time.
- `billable` (Boolean) Whether the time is chargeable.
- `created_at` (String) When the entry was created (RFC 3339).
- `executed_at` (String) When the work was done (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the time entry.
- `note` (String) Description of the work done.
- `start_time` (String) When the timer was started (RFC 3339).
- `ticket_id` (Number) ID of the ticket the time is logged against.
- `time_spent` (String) Duration as HH:MM.
- `timer_running` (Boolean) Whether the entry's timer is counting.
- `updated_at` (String) When the entry was last changed (RFC 3339).
